messages:
nora (New Hire): hi all — starting next Wed from london. couple quick things: 1) when do benefits kick in if you start mid-month? 2) i accidentally enrolled in private health but prefer NHS only, can i undo that? 3) i paid a visa solicitor fee out of pocket; how do i get reimbursed?
julia (People Ops): welcome nora! :wave: generally benefits effective date = 1st of the month after 30 days for mid-month starts. you can opt out of private health but we need a signed opt-out waiver. please upload receipts to the HR portal under "expenses/immigration" for visa fees.
aditi (Benefits): hi nora — pension auto-enrol occurs after 3 months (first payroll cycle after). for the private health opt-out, if you enrolled during onboarding just wait for the waiver from julia and sign it; we can reverse enrollment retroactively to the benefit effective date if within policy.
ora (New Hire): uploaded visa_receipt.pdf and solicitor_invoice.pdf to portal, tagged immigration. also noticed home-office allowance missing from first pay stub.
ora (New Hire): hr-bot ticket created HR-EXP-1999.
hr-bot: Uploads received. Ticket HR-EXP-1999 created. Please add employee-id to the ticket.
mike (Payroll): I see HR-EXP-1999. Once People Ops approves receipts, reimbursement goes into payroll queue. If approved before payroll cutoff (Fri 5pm BST) it'll appear in next run; otherwise the run after. Home-office allowance should be added to next pay; if not, reply with HR-EXP-1999 and i'll make a manual adjustment.
julia (People Ops): thanks nora — i'll DM the opt-out waiver and mark HR-EXP-1999 for priority. welcome aboard! :tada:
